studies.title: Klyuchevskaya Sopka
studies.caption: Snow and dark gullies stripe the steep cone of Klyuchevskaya Sopka.
studies.prompt: Low Kamchatka valley view toward Klyuchevskaya Sopka's tall steep near-symmetrical volcanic cone, long dark radial gullies alternating with snow, thin plume, sparse northern larch in foreground. No Himalayan jagged range or tropical palms.
